name: A killer with clean hands
source:
The protagonist becomes a participant in an investigation into killing people with viruses. Viruses are creatures that invade the virtual world and kill. They can be both objects and living objects. From animals to people. The system removes viruses some time after they have committed the kill. Together with the developer, under the guise of an ordinary player, you have to investigate these incidents and find out who is guilty of killing people and who creates these viruses.

[Translated from [url=https://delv34.itch.io/a-killer-with-clean-hands]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角成为一项关于用病毒杀人的调查的参与者。病毒是侵入虚拟世界并造成杀戮的生物。它们既可以是物体，也可以是有生命的物体。从动物到人。系统会在病毒杀死病毒一段时间后将其删除。你必须与开发者一起，在普通玩家的幌子下调查这些事件，找出谁是杀人罪魁祸首以及谁制造了这些病毒。

[译自[url=https://delv34.itch.io/a-killer-with-clean-hands]itch.io[/url]]
